text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... It's finally... finally... This day 
has actually come, hasn't it~~~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, having come to the zoo for a 
change of pace, I spotted Meisho Doto 
looking sorrowfully at the goat enclosure.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... I heard that the goats here are 
being moved to another zoo... So I came to 
say my final goodbye...
choice_data_list: That really is sad, isn't it?
It's hard not to feel sad about that.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes... We had gotten so close... My chest 
just aches...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
On my days off... I would often talk to 
them over the fence...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
They'd listen to my stories about the 
Academy... And in return, they'd tell me 
about their favorite grasses...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, everyone... You're all setting off 
for a whole new world, aren't you~~~

text_block_list.name: Herd of Goats
text_block_list.text: Baaa~. Baaah~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: E-E-Everyone~... A-A-Actually, umm...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...E-Enka...! There's a farewell song 
that's my specialty... but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...No. But it's way too embarrassing... 
Never mind...

text_block_list.name: Herd of Goats
text_block_list.text:
Baaa baaa~ baaa~? Baaa~... Baa baa! 
Baaah~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Huuuh~!? Y-You really want to hear... my 
enka that much?

text_block_list.name: Herd of Goats
text_block_list.text: Baa, baa-baa~! Baa-baa~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ............ Then... I-I'll try my best...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
......The s-s-snow melts away~~~. 
...Flowing down... to the harbor~~~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Passing by, is it a ship? Or perhaps, 
is it you~~~?

text_block_list.name: Herd of Goats
text_block_list.text: Baa baa~♪ Baaa~♪

text_block_list.name: Zoo Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that... enka~?! Is she singing to 
the goats?!

text_block_list.name: Captivated Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it. ...Wait, doesn't it strike 
deep into your soul? Even if it's 
bittersweet, they really seem to 
understand each other.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
—Ahhh, ahhh, ahhh, ahhh~! Oh waves! Oh 
seagulls~! Forever and ever... I shall 
never forget~! The warmth of that hand~~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That waaaarmth~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Herd of Goats
text_block_list.text: Baaa~! Baaa~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Uuu. H-H-How embarrassing~... I even 
got applause from everyone around us...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But... the goats... Even though it's a 
farewell, they seemed happy... so I'm 
glad.
choice_data_list: Your special talent really came in handy!

Everyone there was completely enchanted by 
your singing!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Special talent... Y-Yeah, I suppose. You 
could call it that... maybe...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if... there are other things... 
that even someone like me can do...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
E-E-E-Enchanted~~~?! N-No way, there's no 
way that's true~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Today was just a song I'm good at, that's 
all...! I-It was just a fluke, 
really~~~...!!
